lines.t: Shadows try to claim me, pull me to the ground
But you were in the whisper, the fire breaking out
Every wound I carried, you turned to burning gold
Now the darkness trembles at the story that you wrote
I was fading, barely breathing
But your love kept reaching in
Now I rise with an unbreakable flame
Your power roaring through my veins
No fear, no chains, I'm alive again
Cause you call my heart by name
And the night can't hold me, no, not again
I burn with an unbreakable flame
Storms were crashing over, I thought I'd drown alone
alone but you were in the thunder the strength within the roar
every doubt that haunted you shattered with your light now i stand unshaken a soldier of your fire
I was fading, almost breaking
But your mercy pulled me in
Now I rise with unbreakable flame
Your power roaring through my veins
No fear, no chains, I'm alive again
Cause you call my heart by name
And the night can't hold me, no, not again
I burn with an unbreakable flame
I won't bow to the fear inside
You're the voice that steadies my fight
With your fire burning bright
You make me unbreakable
Now I rise with an unbreakable flame
Your glory rushing through my veins
All fear erased, I'm alive again
Hell forever in your name
And the night can't stop me, no, not again
I burn with an unbreakable flame
